versionPairs.description: A real Bun 1.3.14 `build --target=bun --format=esm --minify` build of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app) — Bun's ES-module output in its production (minified, Claude Code's) shape: the `// @bun` banner, top-level statements, a real `import{basename}from"path"`, no wrapper function. KNOWN GAP (plugin-spec I25, the P9 bundle layout): --split fails with no recognizable bundle wrapper. v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
